protocol.label: Protocol
protocol.help: Protocol used to connect to the Vacuula server

host.label: Server address
host.help: Hostname, IPv4 or IPv6 address of the Vacuula server, optionally with port (e.g. 192.168.1.10:8080 or [fd00::10]:8080)
host.validator: const h = String(data.host || '').trim(); if (!h || /[\s\/?#@]/.test(h)) { return false; } const v = /^[0-9a-fA-F:.]+$/.test(h) && (h.match(/:/g) || []).length > 1 ? '[' + h + ']' : h; try { return !!new URL('http://' + v).hostname; } catch (e) { return false; }
host.validatorErrorText: Please enter a hostname, IPv4 or IPv6 address without protocol, optionally with port (e.g. 192.168.1.10:8080 or [fd00::10]:8080)

pollInterval.label: Polling interval
pollInterval.help: Interval in seconds for querying robots and their state
